content.description: Iteration 2: keep the iteration-1 structure; shorten discharge headways (tau, sigma, accel) to cut queue length and right-lane blocking; raise early-start and red-running probabilities about tenfold; cut the space-seeking probability and share to reduce sidewalk use; illegal-left riders as in the best-fitting iteration-1 spec.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 0.50-0.63 s vs obs 0.347 s, R 7.5-12) and, through shorter queues, M5/length (38-44 m vs 15.8 m), M9a and M9b: lower tau (0.9 to 0.7), lower sigma (0.4 to 0.3) and higher accel (SUMO default 2.6 to 3.2) shorten the discharge headway after green; the best iteration-1 car (tau 0.9, sigma 0.4) gave 0.50 s.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.38-0.48 s vs obs 0.296 s) and M5/length and M5/moto_density (sim 0.097 vs obs 0.052 veh/m2): tau 0.6 to 0.5, sigma 0.4 to 0.3 and accel at the motorcycle default 6 give a faster discharge, so the queue clears sooner and stays shorter; lateral filtering values kept from iteration 1 (s03, the best M1/M5 result).

Behaviour 10, targets M6/approach/s/moto (sim 38.0 s in s03 vs obs 35.7 s): kept speedFactor 0.7 and 10% share from s03, which gave the closest approach time; tau/sigma lowered slightly like the other riders so the slow minority does not lengthen M1/moto headway.

Targets M10a/per_cycle (sim 1.7-3.6 vs obs 0.56 veh/cycle, weight 0.10, the largest miss): the share of space-seeking custom1 riders drops from 0.25 to 0.20 so fewer riders are eligible for the sidewalk; car-following values equal moto_std so M1/moto is not penalised.

Targets M7a/n_waiting, M7b/clear_lag and M7c/slope: the iteration-1 s02 values (tau 0.8, minGap 1.0, accel 4) gave the best box metrics (n_waiting 4.27 vs 5.59, clear_lag 5.45 vs 5.46 s), while s01/s03 with other values gave 1.6-1.9 waiters, so they are kept unchanged.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.017-0.024 vs obs 0.130, R about 5), M2/first_delay (sim 0.4-1.2 s vs obs 2.83 s) and M4/overshoot_share (sim 0 vs obs 0.62): with p 0.13 only about 1/6 of the intended share was executed, so p is raised to 0.4 and the window widened to the full 10 s of the M2 target; v_max 3 m/s keeps creep speed slow.
Targets M2/early/car (sim 0.001-0.005 vs obs 0.0111): p 0.011 gave about a quarter of the observed share, so p is raised to 0.04 while cars stay mostly compliant.

Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.005-0.007 vs obs 0.098) and M3/per_cycle (sim 0.2-0.3 vs obs 3.9): p0 0.06 produced about a tenth of its nominal share, so p0 goes to 0.5 (the front-row motorcycle value cited in the parameter dictionary) and p_max to 0.8; k 0.05 is kept small because M3/var_to_mean (sim 0.98-1.17 vs obs 1.14) is already within R 1.
Targets M3/share/car (sim 0 vs obs 0.0041): no car rule gave zero red running, and the same tenfold factor seen for motorcycles implies p0 0.04 gives about 0.004; no swarm effect for cars.

Targets M10a/per_cycle (sim 1.7-3.6 vs obs 0.56) and M10b/queue_at_choice (sim 32-56 m vs obs 15.3 m): the number of attempts scaled roughly with the summed option probability (0.27 gave 328, 0.5 gave 642), so the sum drops from 0.5 to 0.08, and the trigger queue q rises from 10 to 15 m (the observed choice queue 15.3-15.7 m) so only real queues start a draw; p_right_lane 0 because the option does not exist on this site.

Targets M7a/release_time (sim 3.74 vs obs 2.78 s) and M7b/clear_lag (5.45 vs 5.46 s): kept at the s02 value of 1.0 s, which matched clear_lag exactly; the release_time excess is small (R 1.9) and lowering the lag would worsen clear_lag.
Behaviour 10, M6/approach/s/moto and M4/lat_moto: no feedback shows the offset is the problem, so the neutral lane-centre value is kept to change few things at a time.

reasoning: The largest misses in iteration 1 are queue length (M5/length 38-44 m vs 15.8 m), the straight vehicles in the right-turn lane (M9a, M9b) and sidewalk use (M10a, weight 0.10, sim 1.7-3.6 vs 0.56), with discharge headways M1 too long (0.38-0.63 s vs 0.30-0.35 s). I shorten tau and sigma and raise accel to cut M1 and the queues, and cut the summed option probability of queue_space_seeking and the seeker share since attempts scaled with it. Early start and red running barely executed (M2/early/moto 0.02 vs 0.13, M3/share/moto 0.006 vs 0.098), so their probabilities are raised by the observed factor of about 6 to 10 (p 0.4, p0 0.5). The illegal-left archetype and rule are kept from s02, which matched M7b clear_lag. wrong_lane (M8) and right_lane have no mechanism on this site, so they are left unchanged.
